Terrible terrible
Aug 2026 • Family
Possibly the worst restaurant experience we have had in Vietnam
This place presents itself as an Italian restaurant, but in our experience it was absolutely nothing like authentic Italian food. We stopped just for ice cream and a few desserts, and it was a huge disappointment.
First of all, there were no prices clearly displayed, so be very careful before ordering. Compared with local prices, what we were charged was ridiculously expensive.
The chocolate cake was tiny and honestly inedible: no real flavour and a terrible texture. The ice cream was even worse. It tasted as if it had been badly made from powder, with such a grainy texture that it felt like eating a bag of sand.
We immediately complained and asked to speak to the chef or the owner, but they refused to let us speak to either of them. Instead, we were simply presented with a bill of almost 600,000 VND for a few desserts that we could barely eat.
Terrible food, terrible value for money and very poor customer service. Based on our experience, I would strongly recommend avoiding this place. There are so many wonderful places to eat in Vietnam — this was definitely not one of them.

joanna ha l
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are sorry to hear that you were disappointed with your experience, although we would like to clarify a few points for the sake of accuracy.

As you mentioned, you visited us specifically for desserts and gelato, rather than dining at our restaurant. We are sorry that the desserts did not meet your expectations.

Regarding the flourless chocolate cake, we would like to clarify that this dessert is made with an **Amaretto almond flavour**, and is not intended to be a pure chocolate-flavoured cake. We understand that this particular flavour profile may simply not have been to your taste.

As for the gelato, we also noted that you finished all of the other flavours you ordered, with the exception of the Thai Milk Tea gelato. We listened to your complaint and, as a gesture of goodwill, **removed the Thai Milk Tea gelato from your bill**, so you were not charged for the particular flavour you were dissatisfied with. We are therefore sorry to see that you still felt your overall experience warranted such a negative assessment.

Regarding the prices, our menu prices are clearly displayed, and the menu also clearly states that **VAT and service charge are additional**. We appreciate that language differences or simply overlooking the information may sometimes cause misunderstandings, but the pricing information is available before an order is placed.

We are always open to feedback, including criticism when something genuinely falls short of a guest's expectations. At the same time, we believe it is important that reviews accurately reflect what took place during the visit.

Nevertheless, we sincerely apologize that you did not enjoy the desserts and gelato, and we thank you for visiting us and taking the time to share your feedback.
